verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly requires permit-ready electrical drawings and an electrical PE stamp as executable project deliverables; pricing and timeline requests are correctly excluded.

ambiguity.description: Whether the freelancer was responsible for creating the electrical drawings, rather than only reviewing and stamping them, required client clarification.

verdicts.decision_note: The source raises a material uncertainty about the electrical drawing-production obligation; the description is narrowed to this Requirement and excludes separately modeled calculations.
The client resolves the uncertainty by confirming that the freelancer must create and stamp the electrical drawings, restoring the drawing-package obligation without changing its existing values.
